info.name: Amplitude Attribution Annotations Retention Analysis API

params.name: se
params.description: The starting event as a JSON-encoded object with event_type field.

params.name: re
params.description: The returning event as a JSON-encoded object with event_type field.

params.name: start
params.description: The start date in YYYYMMDD format.

params.name: end
params.description: The end date in YYYYMMDD format.

params.name: rm
params.description: Retention mode. Use bracket for N-day retention or rolling for unbounded retention.

params.name: s
params.description: Segment definitions as a JSON-encoded array.

items.docs: Get user retention for specific starting and returning actions. Returns retention data broken down by cohort date showing the percentage of users who returned on each subsequent day.
